caption: The drawing shows a full-length, long-sleeved gown rendered in shades of blue with pale trim and patterning. The main fabric of the dress is a rich blue adorned with white, symmetrical, floral or star-like motifs scattered uniformly across the surface. The gown features a fitted bodice with a square neckline that is trimmed with a pale, possibly ivory or beige, ruffle. Down the center front of the dress and along the opening of the skirt, there is a similar pale ruffled trim. The sleeves are elaborately styled with a double layer, the outer blue layer ending at the elbow and opening to reveal an underlayer of light, possibly sheer fabric with a similar white pattern; this underlayer forms wide, ruffled cuffs. To the right of the colored illustration is a line drawing of the back view of the dress, showing the same overall structure without color or pattern. The background of the image is an off-white or beige tone, and there are no additional decorative elements or objects present aside from the dress and its back view sketch.
